description: AGSC-09-13 (the citation record): the body of a `read` answer carries `chunks`, one record for each chunk of the item in the order of AGSC-06-29, with exactly the members `algorithm`, `bundle_version`, `coverage`, `digest`, `id`, `iri`, `item`, `license`, `ordinal`, `section` and `terms` (and `license_url` only where the node has one, which this fixture has not). `algorithm` is `sha-256` and `coverage` is `text`: `digest` is the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the chunk's `text` (AGSC-06-29), so a client that holds the text checks it before it hands it to a model (AGSC-06-44). The item `supervisor` has three chunks: chunk 0 before the first heading, then the sections `intent` and `structure`; their ids and digests are those the chunk lines of the same Bundle carry (`chk-0001`), with the content version `v1.4.0` stated in `bundle_version`. The draft `draft-one` is not published and has no chunk, so its `read` on the local server, which does answer it (AGSC-09-13), carries `chunks` `[]`. The record carries no retrieval time: the client adds it. The same value comes from the page tools over the listed set (AGSC-09-16).
